turns.match: why does ice float? let me guess first
turns.script:
scene stack
say title | Does ice float?
say | A cube of ice goes into a glass of water. Make a guess first.
ask p1 is=floats pick=floats,sinks,melts_at_once | I think the ice __.
hint | Think about whether ice takes up more room than the water it came from.
ask p2 send=no is=lighter pick=lighter,heavier,the_same | So, for the same size, ice is __ than water.
hint | If it floats, which of the two pulls down harder?
